CustomField.description: When CursorBatchStalledJobWatchdog was last enqueued. Stamped on job submission, or by CursorBatchStalledJobWatchdogSchedule, and used to throttle the watchdog to once per Watchdog_Interval_Minutes__c. Clearing this field forces a run on the next job submission.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When the stalled-job watchdog last ran. Clear this to force a run on the next job submission.
CustomField.label: Last Watchdog Run
